creator: main-context
purpose: Wire /dev-eval + /metrics into Claude CLI for live formula feedback
mission_goal: Create real-time feedback loop: /spawn reads formulas → agents work → measurements logged → /metrics shows results → next mutation informed by real data.

context_injection.background: Currently, formula parameters are defined in faerie2-formulas.json but not wired into operational systems. Agents don't know they should adapt behavior based on context%. /metrics doesn't track formula calibration. /dev-eval can't compare baseline vs. mutation because there's no baseline logging.
what_needs_to_exist: 1. Real-time token ledger (every spawn logged with actual /usage delta)
2. Formula violation detection (presend hook warns if /spawn violates gates)
4. Mutation baseline baseline (T+0 measurements before any tweaks)
5. Agent-side formula awareness (agents know their reputation score + wave state)
context_injection.current_gap: We have formulas defined. We have no operational wiring. Result: formulas are aspirational, not enforced.

phase_1_token_ledger.goal: Log ACTUAL token consumption for every spawn, not estimates

tasks.description: Create a presend/postsend hook that logs /usage before/after spawn

action: 1. Call /usage (Claude Code API → get current context metrics)
7. Log entry: { timestamp, wave, agents_count, actual_tokens_burned, theory_predicted, gap }

tasks.description: Merge token-ledger events into the existing metrics-ledger.jsonl for unified /metrics queries
method: Create bridge: spawn_id links token event → agent manifests
Result: /metrics can show: 'W1 spawn burned 4.2K actual vs 5K theory. 3 of 4 agents completed in <5min (cache hit)'

phase_2_formula_enforcement.goal: Make /spawn respect faerie2-formulas.json wave gates (context-aware spawning)

tasks.description: Before /spawn invokes agents, read altimeter + formulas, determine wave automatically

change: 4. Determine wave based on context_pct (not user --wave flag)
6. Override user --wave if it violates gates
(e.g., if user says --wave 1 but context=85%, force W3)

presend_warning.trigger: If user specifies --wave that violates context gates
presend_warning.message: You requested W1, but context=85% (exceeds WAVE_1_SPAWN_MAX_CONTEXT_PCT=70%). Forcing W3 INSERTION (background only). If you want W1, wait until context drops below 70%.

tasks.description: Agents should know the formulas driving their dispatch. Inject faerie2-formulas.json into bundle.

addition: # Wave Thresholds (Why You're Spawned in This Wave)

phase_3_metrics_dashboard.goal: Implement /metrics --formula-tracking to show formula health + calibration gaps

tasks.description: Add new display mode to /metrics: show theory vs. practice for each formula

display: Day 1: context at spawn = 68% (< 70, prediction: W1 4-6 agents)
actual agents spawned = 4.2 avg, cache_hit_rate = 87% ✓ (matches theory)
Day 2: context at spawn = 75% (> 70, prediction: W2 2-3 agents)
actual agents spawned = 2.8 avg, cache_hit_rate = 64% (LOWER than W1)
gap: theory says cache hit drops in W2; practice matches (good calibration)
Day 3: context at spawn = 82% (W3 zone, prediction: background only)
user tried --wave 1 anyway, presend blocked it, forced W3 (gate working)
RECOMMENDATION: Formula is well-calibrated. No adjustment needed.

tasks.description: Track: Do formulas drive emergence? (bundles emitted, droplets cited, discovery depth)

metrics: emergent_work_discovered (tasks found via frontier scan per session)
bundles_emitted_by_agents (% of agents with >40% context who emitted bundles)
droplet_citations (% of manifests that cite droplets)
context_leverage (% of agent context spent on discovery vs. primary)
display: Insight: Bundles are being emitted, discovery happening, but droplets not being reused.
Action: Next mutation: raise EMERGENCE_MULTIPLIER_BASE to encourage droplet reuse.

phase_4_mutation_baseline.goal: Establish T+0 baseline before ANY formula changes

tasks.description: Measure system health with CURRENT formulas (no changes). This is baseline for all future mutations.
method: 1. Run 3 sessions with CURRENT faerie2-formulas.json values (frozen)
6. This is the reference point for all future mutation→eval cycles

baseline_metrics_to_record.wave_distribution: % of spawns at W1 vs W2 vs W3
baseline_metrics_to_record.formula_violations: times /spawn forced wave change due to context gate

phase_5_mutation_protocol.goal: Enable safe formula mutations with measured validation

example_mutation.hypothesis: Raise WAVE_1_SPAWN_MAX_CONTEXT_PCT from 70 to 75. Prediction: cache_hit_rate improves, flywheel stays fast.
example_mutation.measure_T1: Run 3 sessions, collect same metrics as T0
example_mutation.analysis: Positive emergence: cache hit improved, more agents, fewer compacts. Equilibrium: ✓ (no new work added)
example_mutation.log_mutation: git commit -m 'mutation: WAVE_1_SPAWN_MAX_CONTEXT_PCT 70→75 (improved cache hit +7%, agents +14%, compacts -8%)'

deliverables: 1. Token ledger hook (logs real /usage deltas per spawn)
2. Context gate enforcement in /spawn (respects WAVE_*_MAX_CONTEXT_PCT formulas)
5. T+0 baseline locked in git (immutable reference for mutations)
6. Mutation protocol documentation (how to safely test formula changes)
success_criteria: ✓ Every spawn logs actual token usage (no more estimates)
✓ /spawn auto-gates waves based on real context% (not user preference)
✓ /metrics shows formulas are well-calibrated OR identifies gaps
✓ Next mutation test can compare theory vs practice with hard numbers
